div.style: max-width: 500px; background: #fff; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31,38,135,0.15); padding: 32px;

textarea.style: width:100%; min-height:80px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid #e0e0e0; padding:12px; font-size:16px; margin-bottom:16px; resize:vertical; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(94,114,228,0.05);

button.style: width:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5e72e4 0%,#825ee4 100%); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 0; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(94,114,228,0.15); transition:background 0.2s;

div.style: margin-top:24px; background:#f7f8fa; border-radius:8px; min-height:40px; padding:16px; color:#232526; font-size:15px; box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(94,114,228,0.07);
